source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of scalability and resource management (PDF 160).

blocks.text: Cloud services wasail khud barha ya ghata sakti hain, maslan urooj ke waqt servers barhana aur baad mein hatana. Ghair zaroori laagat se bachne aur kaarkardagi buland rakhne ke liye wasail ka mo-assar intezam, istemal ki nigrani aur kaarkardagi behtar banana, zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar elastic cloud ki koi nigrani na kare to kya ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Wasail be-wajah chalte ya barhte reh sakte hain aur bill barh sakta hai, ya bohat kam set hon aur service sust ho.

items: Scalability ko wasail ka intezam chahiye: laagat aur kaarkardagi ke liye istemal ki nigrani.
